name: Clean Titles
description: Renames VOD movies and series in the catalogue to their official titles, looked up by each title's TMDB ID. Removes provider prefixes and tags like 'EN - ... (US)'. Keeps each original name so every rename can be reverted. Can also replace the providers' many categories with the streaming services you select (Netflix, Disney+, Tubi...). Dry run by default. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
author: Brxdy22

fields.label: TMDB API key
fields.help_text: Free key from themoviedb.org (Settings > API). Either the short 'API Key' or the long 'API Read Access Token' works.

fields.label: Dry run (look up, but rename nothing)
fields.help_text: ON: looks titles up and reports what it would rename, writes nothing. OFF: renames.

fields.label: Name format
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr shows the year separately, so plain Title is usually best.

fields.label: Title language
fields.help_text: Language TMDB gives the title in.

fields.label: Remove titles in other languages
fields.help_text: Deletes titles whose original and spoken languages on TMDB don't include the Title language, after each VOD scan. Dispatcharr can't hide titles, and a scan brings them back for a moment until this runs. Titles TMDB has no language for are kept. Use Preview Language Filter first. Turning this off and refreshing the account brings them back, with new IDs.

fields.label: Keep anime in other languages
fields.help_text: Keeps Japanese animation, anything listed on Crunchyroll, and anything in a provider's anime category, because TMDB can't see dubs.

fields.label: Max TMDB lookups per second
fields.help_text: TMDB allows about 40-50 per second. 20 renames ~30,000 titles in under half an hour.

fields.label: Select Streaming Services to Use + Priority
fields.help_text: These become your VOD categories, replacing the providers' own, most important first: a title on several goes to the first one here, paid or free. Kids titles go to a service's Kids category. Titles on none of them go to the category set below. Leave this empty to stop sorting. The list shows services in your Streaming region, most popular first. Drag a service to change its priority, and type to search the list. Starz, AMC+ and MGM+ are last resorts: they only win when none of the others streams the title, even for their own originals. After changing the region, Save and press Reload Plugin at the top of this page to update this list.

fields.label: Drag and search in the service list
fields.help_text: Adds dragging and search to the field above, by adding a small script to Dispatcharr's page. Turn this off to use the plain list, where priority is the order you pick services. Refresh the page after changing this.

fields.label: Movies in theaters go to
fields.help_text: Movies on none of your selected services that TMDB lists as now playing in cinemas (in the streaming region) go to this category. Empty: off.

fields.label: Titles only for rent or sale go to
fields.help_text: Titles TMDB lists only for rent or purchase, with no subscription or free service at all, go to this category. Empty: off.

fields.label: Titles on none of these services go to
fields.help_text: Titles on none of your selected services (or not on TMDB) go to this category. Empty: Uncategorized.

actions.label: Rename Run
actions.description: Starts a background run over every movie/series with a TMDB ID that hasn't been renamed yet. With Dry run on, only reports. Also runs after each M3U refresh, but only for accounts with Enable VOD Scanning on: it waits for that account's VOD scan to finish, then fixes posters and renames that account's new titles. Follow it with Status.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Progress of the current run, or the result of the last one.

actions.label: Stop Run
actions.description: Stops the current run after the title in progress.

actions.label: Tag Duplicates
actions.description: Titles that exist twice (same TMDB ID, split by provider category) get a short provider tag so you can tell them apart, e.g. 'Zero Day [EN]' / 'Zero Day [NF]'. 4K is left out of the tag ('4K-D+' -> 'D+') unless both '4K-D+' and 'D+' exist. Runs automatically at the end of every real Rename Run. Honors Dry run.

actions.label: Unify Series
actions.description: Shows each series once: folds the copies Dispatcharr keeps apart (older shows carry a legacy empty language, so a second provider's copy of the same show becomes a separate entry) into one show with every provider behind it. Playback follows M3U account priority, and Dispatcharr's player lets you pick the provider. New episodes and new providers join automatically afterwards. With Dry run on, only reports. Undo with Revert Unify.

confirm.title: Unify series?
confirm.message: Copies of the same show from different providers become one show. Dry run only reports. Revert Unify splits them again.

actions.label: Fix Images
actions.description: Finds titles whose poster points at an image server that isn't answering (or that have no poster) and gives them the TMDB poster instead. Only the poster changes. Also runs after each M3U refresh of an account with Enable VOD Scanning on, because a refresh points them back at the provider's image. With Dry run on, only reports.

actions.label: Apply Streaming Categories
actions.description: Moves titles from the providers' categories into your selected streaming services, for both providers. Only the category a title is listed under changes, never its streams. Also runs after each VOD scan, because a scan puts titles back in the provider's categories. The first run looks up every title's streaming service on TMDB (a few minutes); later runs only look up new titles. With Dry run on, only reports. Undo with Revert Streaming Categories.

actions.label: Preview Language Filter
actions.description: Lists the titles the language filter would remove, and never deletes anything. The first run looks up every title on TMDB (several minutes). The full list is saved as language_report.txt in the plugin's data folder.

actions.label: Remove Other Languages
actions.description: Deletes the titles the preview lists, right now. Needs Remove titles in other languages on, and honors Dry run. Refuses if more than 40% of the movies or series would go.

confirm.title: Remove titles in other languages?
confirm.message: Titles the preview lists are deleted. They only come back if you turn the filter off and refresh the account, with new IDs.

actions.label: Re-check Renamed Titles
actions.description: Makes the next Rename Run look up already-renamed titles again too (for example after changing the name format or language).

actions.label: Revert Unify
actions.description: Splits every series combined by Unify Series back into its separate copies. Renames stay. Runs in the background.

confirm.title: Revert unify?
confirm.message: Every unified series is split back into one entry per provider copy.

actions.label: Revert Streaming Categories
actions.description: Puts every title back in its provider's own category and removes the shared categories. To keep it that way, also empty the streaming services list (otherwise the next VOD scan sorts them again).

confirm.title: Revert streaming categories?
confirm.message: Every title goes back to its provider's own category.

actions.label: Revert All Renames
actions.description: Puts every renamed title back to the provider's original name. Runs in the background.

confirm.title: Revert every rename?
confirm.message: All movies and series renamed by this plugin get their original provider names back.
